messages:
maria: Hey infra — vendor reports rack-058 cleared customs but the on-site team found a PDU mismatch. ETA move-forward is +48h unless we can approve a PDU swap. We have a customer demo next Tue 14:00 PST, can we confirm provisioning of 8 GPUs into the demo tenant by then?
jonathan: Thx. Which card mix are we expecting? H100 only or mixed?
maria: Mixed: vendor confirmed 4x H100 + 8x A10G across the rack. They can fast-track the H100 trays if we provide a terraform runbook / on-site install steps. Serial numbers are pending until swap approved.
kevin: I can prep a TF module for the on-site team. Quick preference: do you want a single module that registers the whole rack or per-rack-slot resources?
maria: single module is fine, with variables for rack_id and slice. Keeps the ops path simpler.
kevin: example snippet I’ll base it on: 
```
module "vendor_rack" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/infra.git//modules/vendor-rack/staging"
  rack_id = "rack-058"
  gpu_slice = "demo-8"
}
```
ashley: Heads-up — demo tenant quota is currently 6 GPUs, so we need a short quota bump to hit 8. @finance any objections to a transient bump for the demo window? :eyes:
finance-bot: Quota request created: QREQ-8921. Approver: @sophie. Estimated approval ETA: 24-36h.
jonathan: If the quota is going to lag, fallback plan: we can route the demo workload to 4 H100s in the dedicated pool and keep remaining inference on hosted (smaller GPUs). That would need a routing policy update but no model repin.
maria: Correct — routing policy change only. I can prepare a canary rollout policy to prefer dedicated pool for demo-tenant/* routes.
kevin: Opening PR for TF + runbook, assigning to @maria for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4123
maria: Nice. If finance approves we ask vendor to expedite PDU swap and push installers. If not, we start the fallback shift tomorrow morning.
ashley: I’ll ping Sophie now.
oncall-infra: acknowledged. I’ll monitor the delivery window and set an alert if ETA slips >12h.
jonathan: One more optimization — can vendor share serials early so we can pre-flash firmware images? That saves ~2-3h on-site.
maria: Asked vendor to email serials, cc @kevin.
kevin: Received serials via email just now, prepping firmware bake. ETA to finish image prep: ~3h.
maria: Perfect. I’ll update the thread when finance responds or vendor confirms swap. Thanks all.
